title: Line Counter
story: How many real lines are in a letter? Blank lines do not count.
goal: Write count_lines(path) returning the number of non-empty lines in the file.
hints: You can loop over an open file line by line.
line.strip() is empty for a blank line.
socratic: How do you read a file one line at a time?
How can you tell a line is blank?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Line Counter”?
